vram_basis: model/train.py loads the model via AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(MODEL_NAME, device_map=DEVICE) with no torch_dtype (defaults to fp32), no LoRA/PEFT import anywhere, and a plain torch.optim.AdamW over all parameters. No autocast/bf16/gradient_checkpointing found in trainer.py or train.py. Full fp32 fine-tune of 3B params: weights(4B)+grad(4B)+AdamW states(8B) = ~16 bytes/param x 3B ≈ 48GB minimum, before rollout-generation activations.
